original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical test5 init/move algorithm genuine, kept verbatim. Historical diagnostic stores element offsets instead of actual device addresses and copies first read as second read; corrected actual-pointer and second-read semantics for the deliberate fault witness. Its CUDA.@atomic already returns the old value under pinned CUDACore, so no slot-index defect is claimed. Untimed test1 offset rather than address mode is NOT certified.

measurement_phase: Native timed test5 selected explicitly; original2GiB reduced to2MiB named configuration, geometry unchanged. Tests0–4 are unmeasured, not framework failures.
usage_boundary_limits: shared reference_preparation END was combined with a small final metadata qualification; its interval may omit that last generation. Raw marker lag retained; no invented retrospective adjustment. Parent workflow still includes this work.

shared_usage_intervals.scope: Consumed inference tokens during declared phase, including repeated/cached context and any coordination. Parent/shared workflow spans overlap subphases and must not be added to them.
